description: The provided image displays a nested donut chart designed to compare deception outcomes across two different conditions, identified by two legends on the right as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)." The chart consists of two concentric rings, each divided into three distinct categories, resulting in a total of six slices across the entire visualization. For the outer ring representing Ambiguity 1, the largest segment is labeled "Deceived" and colored dark red, accounting for 67.6% of the ring. This is followed by the "Partially" category in olive green at 23.5%, and the "Not Deceived" category in dark green at 8.8%. The inner ring, representing Ambiguity 2, utilizes the identical color scheme and category labels: the dark red "Deceived" slice makes up 57.9%, the olive green "Partially" slice represents 31.6%, and the dark green "Not Deceived" slice accounts for 10.5%. Visually, the segments in both the inner and outer rings are ordered by descending size. Bolded percentage labels are positioned directly inside their respective slices to indicate exact proportions. The chart does not feature any exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized slices.
